purpose: Bind the V34 scientific endpoint spelling to the exact public WhestBench output bytes before any data, meter, score, package, or submission release.

accepted_d11_one_file.finding: Estimator.predict returns _predict_corrected; the production return is a finite float32 array with depth-major geometry.

whestbench_scoring_contract.finding: Predictions must have shape (depth,width), are materialized as float32 inside the metered window, and the primary raw score uses row -1.

frozen_v34_design.finding: Section 4 binds prediction_15 = deployed_15 + r_15; intermediate response states are recurrence state, not edits to public rows 1 through 14.

current_endpoint_only_deploy.finding: fused_source_on returns a diagnostic dictionary whose source-on value is only a float64 endpoint; it is not a lawful public estimator return.

frozen_training_inference.finding: Normalization arrays are float64; normalized features are cast contiguous float32 before both float32 affine layers; standardized outputs are cast float64 before multiplying float64 label_rms.

stale_static_integration_contract.finding: The provisional scaffold quantizes all 51 normalizer values to float32 and therefore understates the payload as 3,800 bytes.

stale_static_assembler.finding: The synthetic parity recurrence edits rows 1 through 15 and serializes every tensor as float32; those semantics are not the frozen deploy contract.

authoritative_public_return.row_0_through_14: byte-identical copy of the accepted D11 parent rows 0 through 14
authoritative_public_return.response_layer_scope: Only row 15 is overlaid. The r1 through r14 values are recurrence state and may not replace public rows 1 through 14.
authoritative_public_return.clipping: none; any clipping or nonnegativity projection would be a new scientific spelling
authoritative_public_return.return_value: the full float32 array, never an endpoint vector or diagnostic dictionary

exact_construction_order: Obtain the literal accepted-D11 parent output and prove shape [16,1024], dtype float32, finiteness, and capture-enabled byte parity.
Run the frozen head with trainer-identical mixed-dtype normalization and affine order.
Run the fused physical response recurrence in float64 through r15; retain intermediate states only as streaming recurrence state.
Create one full float32 parent copy, replace only row 15 with endpoint32, and return that full array.

head_and_payload_dtype_contract.normalization_and_affine_order: (head24_float64-center_float64)/scale_float64 -> contiguous float32 -> affine32/ReLU/affine32 -> float64 -> multiply label_rms_float64

source_zero_contract.zero_point: set dV,d3,d4 to exact zero after frozen head inference
source_zero_contract.required_fast_path: return the unmodified accepted-D11 parent full output without addition, cast, concatenation, clipping, or row replacement
source_zero_contract.required_identity: shape, dtype, C-order bytes, and SHA256 equal the capture-enabled accepted-D11 parent output
source_zero_contract.reason: Arithmetic add-zero is not the byte-identity contract, even if a synthetic fixture happens to round back to the parent.

scientific_and_package_byte_identity.scientific_raw_score_input: the exact persisted float32 packaged endpoint bytes

public_output_resource_and_copy_accounti.accounting_boundary: The 69,632-byte assembly reserve is in addition to the already-live parent, fused response, head, provider, and scratch buffers. A lower claim requires an exact liveness proof.
public_output_resource_and_copy_accounti.measurement_requirement: Meter the literal full-return estimator path, including output copy, row replacement, dtype conversion, Whest materialization, FlopScope count, absolute RSS, wall time, and returned shape/dtype. Endpoint-only metering is nonbinding.

blocking_repairs_before_any_release: Replace endpoint-only deploy return with the full [16,1024] float32 construction.
Make deploy head inference byte-identical to trainer inference and preserve all 51 normalizers as float64.
Change held semantic and official target payloads from float64 source-on endpoints to the exact float32 packaged endpoint relation.
Replace the synthetic all-row response parity test with final-row-only source-on coverage and an explicit source-zero parent-byte fast-path test.
Update payload accounting from 3,800 to 4,004 uncompressed bytes.
Obtain independent static audits and a complete exact-source resource measurement after these bytes freeze.
